items.title: Al Gallodoro Interview, 1966-05-10
items.q: Interviewer mentions Harry Glenn's tongue technique; Interviewee responds generally about double/triple tonguing without referencing a personal interaction with Glenn.

ctx.x: Yes, but can you still double tongue it if it's a little too slow?
Yes, yes it can be done, sure. In fact, Harry Glenn's human. Yes, sure. He had a very poor single tongue. Well, I don't have the greatest, I'll admit it. He's going to double with everything.
Yes, yes. Many things, I double and triple tongue slow.
